skills.name: Venus health factor report
skills.description: Health factor (3 dp), per-market collateral factor and liquidation threshold, per-asset liquidation price, primary collateral, and the exact USD repayment that restores a target health factor, read from the Venus Comptroller at a given block (default latest). Send text naming the account (and optionally 'Block: N' and a target) or a data part {"address", "blockNumber", "targetHealthFactor"}. The answer is a JSON object in a text part (and the same object in a data part).
examples: Account: 0x60AA3AEE06E2345A17E4d4B12c53E046F4F63CAf. Report its Venus health factor and the USD of debt to repay to restore a health factor of 2.5.

skills.name: Negotiate an ERC-8183 health-factor job
skills.description: Send a data part {"skill": "negotiate-erc8183-job", "task_description": "<text or JSON naming a 0x Venus account>", "terms": {"deliverables": "...", "quality_standards": "..."}} and receive the bnbagent-SDK NegotiationResult: a quote signed (EIP-191) by the agent wallet 0x15A97307cAA68C24E4b5a0b83D331A6AA1EA195F, 10000000000000000 base units of U (0xcE24439F2D9C6a2289F741120FE202248B666666) on BNB Smart Chain, valid 900 s, bound to chain 56 and AgenticCommerce 0xea4daa3100a767e86fded867729ae7446476eba6. Fund within 15 minutes of the quote. Put the description built from it into createJob (evaluator = hook = EvaluatorRouter), register the OptimisticPolicy, setBudget, fund: Vitals delivers automatically.
examples: {"skill": "negotiate-erc8183-job", "task_description": "{\"address\": \"0x60AA3AEE06E2345A17E4d4B12c53E046F4F63CAf\", \"targetHealthFactor\": 2.5}", "terms": {"deliverables": "Venus health factor report as JSON", "quality_standards": "Read on chain, reconciles with getAccountLiquidity"}}

skills.name: Notify that a job is funded
skills.description: Optional: after funding, send {"skill": "notify_funded", "job_id": <int>}. Vitals also watches the chain, so a funded job is delivered without this. Replies at once with {"status": "accepted"|"rejected", "job_id"}; the deliverable URL rides in the submit transaction.

skills.name: ERC-8183 job status
skills.description: Send {"skill": "erc8183-job-status", "job_id": <int>} for the on-chain state of a job and its deliverable.
